title: Sharpen selected nested widths to K/N < 3.0694 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove a scoped fractional-moment improvement for the unchanged selected #4470 mathematical nested compiler:

```text
#5067: p=1        -> K/N < 3.070
this:  p=511/512  -> K/N < 3.0694
```

The uniform source-logarithm envelope decreases from `197115103572543` to `197100824008381`. The new proof bounds both productive and paid fractional moments, including all completion and split terms, by `2^18291`. It uses JoyboyBrian's #5067 root/nonroot source census as a cited premise and answers its Open next question 1. It does not audit that predecessor.

Claim type: scoped mathematical proof with exact finite corroboration. No new kappa or physical admission. The first proved improvement is shipped without an exponent search.

## Evidence

- Before: #5067's first-moment envelope gives `K/N < 3.070`.
- After: exact integer/rational power enclosures and a fully charged split bound prove `K/N < 3.0694`; 458 new tiny source-moment fixtures, 32 split-moment fixtures and three discriminating examples pass. No product histogram or integer of size N is materialized.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct commands pass, timed at 0.03 seconds each locally on macOS with CPython 3.12.15. Both registered commands pass. Generated receipts bind all five package files.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes at `b609781074e982ab89fb54c0f897b17ec2789bb6`. Official export integrity and read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay pass; all eight exported files remain unchanged. Five additional invoice/domain/source mutations reject.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error research/fractional-source-width/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -B -W error research/fractional-source-width/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fractional-source-width
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/fractional-source-width --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 installation can replace the interpreter path. Expected marker: `PASS_FRACTIONAL_SOURCE_WIDTH K/N<3.0694 no_new_kappa`.

## Limitations

The #5067 census and retained compiler semantics are cited premises. Physical stock, routing, native/all-column realization, owned storage, whole-job adapters, precision/tape and analytic/recovery obligations remain inherited. No Lean, Docker, selected operator replay or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. All registered checks ran locally. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Related open work

The refreshed open-PR and claim search found no other open contribution targeting this fractional source bound or the selected complex nested-width coefficient. Closest predecessors #5067 and #5026 are merged. Other stock and compiler proposals have different physical or batching contracts; this result preserves the selected nested recurrence and its invoice.

## Open next questions

- Can a boundary-sensitive moment or another fixed exponent tighten the mathematical bound while retaining every completion and split term?
- Can the actual stock/ownership/routing caller realize the permitted width at its complete tariff?
